heading.en: How fast at exactly t = 2 s?
heading.kn: ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ t = 2 s ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ವೇಗ?

hook.en: A stone dropped from a cliff falls s = 4.9t² metres in t seconds. Average speeds over shorter and shorter intervals after t = 2 s close in on one number: 19.6 m/s.
hook.kn: ಬಂಡೆಯಿಂದ ಬೀಳಿಸಿದ ಕಲ್ಲು t ಸೆಕೆಂಡುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ s = 4.9t² ಮೀಟರ್ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. t = 2 s ನಂತರದ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅಂತರಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಜವ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯತ್ತ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: 19.6 m/s.

objectives.en: See instantaneous velocity as a limit of average velocities
Link the derivative to the slope of a tangent

narration.en: A stone dropped from a cliff falls s = 4.9t² metres in t seconds. Average speeds over shorter and shorter intervals after t = 2 s close in on one number: 19.6 m/s.
narration.kn: ಬಂಡೆಯಿಂದ ಬೀಳಿಸಿದ ಕಲ್ಲು t ಸೆಕೆಂಡುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ s = 4.9t² ಮೀಟರ್ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. t = 2 s ನಂತರದ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅಂತರಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಜವ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯತ್ತ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: 19.6 m/s.

body.en: The average velocity over $[t_1, t_2]$ is $\frac{s(t_2) - s(t_1)}{t_2 - t_1}$. For $s = 4.9t^2$ starting at $t = 2$: over $[2, 2.1]$ it is 20.09 m/s, over $[2, 2.01]$ 19.649 m/s, over $[2, 2.001]$ 19.6049 m/s. Intervals ending at 2 give values just below 19.6. The common limiting value, 19.6 m/s, is the instantaneous velocity: the derivative of $s$ at $t = 2$.
body.kn: ಕಾಲದ ಅಂತರ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದಂತೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗಗಳು 19.6 m/s ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಬೆಲೆಯತ್ತ ಸಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಆ ಮಿತಿ ಬೆಲೆಯೇ t = 2 ರಲ್ಲಿ s ನ ಅವಕಲಜ.

points.en: Average velocity = slope of a chord
Instantaneous velocity = slope of the tangent

narration.en: As the time interval shrinks, the average velocities settle down to one value, 19.6 metres per second. That limiting value is the derivative of s at t equals 2.
narration.kn: ಕಾಲದ ಅಂತರ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದಂತೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗಗಳು 19.6 m/s ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಬೆಲೆಯತ್ತ ಸಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಆ ಮಿತಿ ಬೆಲೆಯೇ t = 2 ರಲ್ಲಿ s ನ ಅವಕಲಜ.

narration.en: A stone falls from rest: in t seconds it falls 4.9 t squared metres. Here is that curve.

say.en: A stone falls from rest: in t seconds it falls 4.9 t squared metres. Here is that curve.
Between t equal to 2 and t equal to 3 it falls from 19.6 to 44.1 metres. The average speed is the slope of this chord: 24.5 metres per second.
Shrink the interval to h seconds. The average speed is 19.6 plus 4.9 h, so it creeps down towards 19.6 as h gets smaller.
The limit, 19.6 metres per second, is the speed at the instant t equal to 2: the slope of the tangent. That limit is the derivative.

caption.en: The graph of a quadratic such as s = 4.9t² gets steeper as t grows. The slope of the tangent at a point is the instantaneous rate of change there.

tryThis.en: Pick a point and imagine a chord to a nearby point shrinking until it becomes the tangent.
Compare how steep the curve is at two different points.

narration.en: The graph of a quadratic such as s = 4.9t² gets steeper as t grows. The slope of the tangent at a point is the instantaneous rate of change there. Pick a point and imagine a chord to a nearby point shrinking until it becomes the tangent.

caption.en: The orange chord joins t = 2 and t = 2 + h on s = 4.9t². Shrink h and watch the chord turn into the green tangent.

narration.en: The orange chord joins t = 2 and t = 2 + h on s = 4.9t². Shrink h and watch the chord turn into the green tangent. Halve h again and again: the average speed drops by 4.9 × (the change in h).

tryThis.en: Halve h again and again: the average speed drops by 4.9 × (the change in h).
At h = 0.05 the chord and the tangent almost coincide.
Why can we not simply put h = 0 in the average?

problem.en: For s = 4.9t², find the average velocity over [2, 2.5] and compare it with 19.6 m/s.

steps.en: It is larger than 19.6 m/s because the stone keeps speeding up during the interval.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For s = 4.9t², find the average velocity over [2, 2.5] and compare it with 19.6 m/s.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Average velocity is the slope of a chord.
Shrinking the interval gives the instantaneous velocity.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ ಎಂದರೆ ಜ್ಯಾದ ಇಳಿಜಾರು. ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ತಾತ್ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವೇಗ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವಕಲಜ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕದ ಇಳಿಜಾರು.
